text:
Alex: Heads up — I’m seeing a growing backlog in the admin ingest backfill job and a bunch of playbook automations firing twice for the same accounts. Started ~0200 UTC, still trickling in.
Mira: Ugh. Any logs yet? root cause hypothesis?
Sam: Quick note: our ingest rate limiter was set to 200/min during the maintenance window. Backfill queued ~2.5M records, it’s chunking and retrying when it hits transient 429s which dupes playbook webhooks.
csops-bot: ALERT: backfill-job-1789 started 02:03 UTC — 92% of tasks queued, 12% retries.
Alex: Example duplicate payloads in the webhook queue: `{"account_id":"acct_abc123","event":"onboard_complete","idempotency_key":null}` — missing keys on older backfill items.
Jordan: We should throttle playbook triggers rather than disabling the whole backfill. Can we add a transient debounce at the playbook runner? 5s window per account would avoid duplicates in most cases.
Mira: Debounce would help, but we also need idempotency keys on backfill output. Sam — can the backfill writer stamp a stable key derived from account_id + event + created_at?
Sam: Yep. I’ll push a tiny change to stamp `idempotency_key` using `sha256(account_id|event|source_seq)` on the writer. Deploy in ~30m.
Lee: I can run a one-off dedupe pass over the webhook queue to drop obvious duplicates before the change lands. Prefer to run in staging then prod.
Alex: Good plan. Also let's temporarily increase the rate limiter to 500/min for the backfill worker to reduce retries (ops risk understand). Sam: increased to 500/min in staging, monitoring CPU/GPU? (worker cpu spike expected).
csops-bot: NOTE: rate-limiter-config updated for backfill-worker by Sam at 02:35 UTC.
Mira: Will run a sampling script to surface accounts that got multiple playbook_runs in the last 4h. Putting the sample in #shared-sheets.
Jordan: We should also add a safety flag in the playbook: if the same playbook_run for account + automation_id has fired in last 1h, skip. Minimal change, low risk.
Sam: Pushed idempotency key change to staging (branch: backfill/idempotency). Example payload now: `{"account_id":"acct_abc123","event":"onboard_complete","idempotency_key":"a3f5..."}`
Lee: Ran dedupe dry-run on a 10k sample — estimated 1.8% duplicates, mostly from retries. Results: `duplicates_found: 178`. Looks safe to run live after approvals.
Alex: Approve live dedupe + deploy idempotency + debounce on runner. Who wants to own prod run? Lee?
Lee: I’ll own exec. ETA 1h. I’ll post start/complete messages and the dedupe command I ran: ```
# dedupe-webhook-queue.sh
python tools/dedupe_queue.py --queue webhooks --cutoff 2024-06-01T00:00:00Z --confirm
```
Mira: After this we should add a short doc in CS admin runbook: how backfills should be instrumented (idempotency, sample size, safe rate limits). I’ll draft it.
Jordan: Queue: add unit test for playbook-runner to assert skip-if-recent-run behavior. Low friction.
Sam: Monitoring: added a temporary dashboard tile for duplicate playbook run rate and queue retry count. Will keep alarm if duplicates > 0.5% for >15m.
csops-bot: ACTION: postmortem ticket created — PMT-3492 "Backfill webhook duplication during admin ingest". Assigned: Mira, Sam, Lee.
Alex: Thanks all. Quick follow-ups: Mira — doc; Sam — prod deploy of idempotency & rate change; Jordan — debounce PR; Lee — dedupe run + result. Will do a 30m sync after dedupe completes. :thumbsup:
Mira: Copy that. I’ll populate the ticket with samples and the shared-sheet link.
Lee: Starting dedupe in 10. Will keep channel updated.
Sam: Rolling deploy to prod in 12m.
Alex: Closing loop — ping here when done, then we’ll schedule a short retro tomorrow.
